parsed.name: small_cap_catalyst_oct_nov_2026
parsed.strategy: Bet on a dense Oct 12-Nov 13 calendar of small/mid-cap dated catalysts: FDA PDUFAs (AGIO Nov 1, SMMT Nov 14, CAPR/SVRA Nov 22, BBIO Nov 27, COGT Nov 30, CORT Dec 17, MLYS Dec 22, PRAX Dec 27) plus confirmed Q3 prints (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, TER Oct 27, SAAB and EVO Oct 23, KOG Oct 29, ALL Nov 12) and Hon Hai Tech Day Oct 30-31. Every name has a dated event inside the window and positive revision_flow_90d where available. I would be wrong if a CRL cluster hits the biotech sleeve simultaneously, or if a single AI-capex digestion headline drags ASML/TSM/TER/2317.TW down together.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 via dated small/mid-cap catalysts.
